meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the committee proceeded with the review of the Cybersecurity Bill. In this regard, Member for Hulhumalé North Constituency Hussain Shareef proposed to amend the entire bill to include Dhivehi terminology where applicable, and in cases where using a Dhivehi term might lead to conflicting meanings or where an English term is strictly necessary, to note the English term within brackets. Following this, the committee reviewed the bill from Article 1 (Section 1) up to Article 30 (Section 30).

meetings.title: 8th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: The meeting was convened to establish a deadline for the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill and the Digital Identity Bill. A motion was proposed by MP Adam Shafeeq of Makunudhoo Constituency to set 31 October 2026 as the deadline for completing the committee’s work on the bills. This motion was seconded by MP Faruhath Mohamed of South Kulhudhuffushi Constituency. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present at the time of voting. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.) The members then discussed setting a deadline for the submission of public feedback and comments from relevant institutions on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill and the Digital Identity Bill. A motion was proposed by MP Adam Shafeeq of Makunudhoo Constituency to set 3 August 2026 as the deadline to solicit public feedback and comments from relevant institutions. This proposal was seconded by MP Faruhath Mohamed of South Kulhudhuffushi Constituency. The motion was passed unanimously by the members present at the time of voting. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.)

meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: Today’s meeting continued with a meeting with the National Center for Information Technology (NCIT) to discuss the issue of preventing the circulation of photos and videos of dresses that are contrary to the general social norms on social media. NCIT has informed us that most of the matters relating to the issue are within the jurisdiction of the Communication Authority of the Maldives (CAM). Hithaadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Siruhaan proposed to study the fraudulent pyramid sales schemes on social media. It was seconded by North Hulhumale Constituency Member Hussain Shareef. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present on the committee. In addition to the above motion, South Henveyru Constituency Member Hussain Imran Latheef proposed a meeting with the relevant authorities to discuss steps to combat fraudulent pyramid sales schemes, online gambling platforms, and all cases of social media scamming, as well as measures to prosecute such perpetrators. It was seconded by South Kulhudhuffushi Constituency Member Faruhath Mohamed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present on the committee.

meetings.title: 3rd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: Today’s meeting, continued to review the decision made at the committee's 2 nd meeting on April 16, 2025, to meet the Maldives Broadcasting Commission of Maldives and relevant authorities at our upcoming meeting regarding the issue of preventing the circulation of photos and videos of dresses that are contrary to the general social norms on social media. Makunudhoo Constituency Member Adam Shafeeq proposed rejecting the decision since the matter does not appear to be within the scope of the Maldives Broadcasting Commission, nor is the commission within the mandate of this committee. It was seconded by Maradhoo Constituency Member Ahmed Didi. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Thereafter, North Hulhumale Constituency Member Hussain Shareef proposed to meet Maldives National Centre for Information Technology and Communication Authority to discuss the matter. It was seconded by North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad. (It was approved without a vote as neither of the committee members objected to it.)

meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the committee discussed on passing the draft of the guidelines to regulate the meetings. South Henveyru constituency member Hussain Imran Latheef proposed to approve the draft of the committee’s procedural draft. The proposal was seconded by Dhangethi constituency member Abdulla Rasheed. The proposal was unanimously approved by the committee. Then, South Henveyru constituency member Hussain Imran Latheef raised the issue on an explanation behind the Bank of Maldives' erroneous deposits massive amounts of money into multiple account simultaneously. The committee members decided that the chairman initially speaks with the speaker of the Majlis about the issue before sending a letter for explanation to the Bank of Maldives.

meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the agenda was the election of the committee Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the committee, as the newly elected members were allocated to the committees in the 2nd sitting of the 20th Majlis. Director General Legal Affairs Aminath Asma conducted the election of the Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad proposed to elect Milandhoo Constituency Member Hassan Mufeed Abdul Gadir as the Chairperson of the Committee. It was seconded by Makunudhoo Constituency Member Adam Shafeeq. Below are the voting details for the appointment. South Kulhudhuffushi Constituency Member Faruhath Mohamed proposed to elect North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad as the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. It was seconded by South Henveyru Constituency Member Hussain Imran Latheef. Below are the voting details for the appointment.
